integrity: The manuscript specifies a fully finite-dimensional self-adjoint precision, exact theorem and proof; independent audit is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Three noiseless orbit observations on equal-weight cycles of size divisible by nine, proper Gaussian mass only.
Unrestricted pinned-cycle trace extremality and classical equispacing are prior results.
The zero-mass statement is a limiting formula, not a Gaussian prior with singular precision.
title: Primitive three-orbit sampling separates trace, determinant, and worst-case Gaussian uncertainty
